  • Discovery

    /

    01

    Understanding the problem comes first.

    Timeframe

    2–3 days

    We study the context.

    We define the goal.

    We clarify the constraints.

  • Strategy

    /

    02

    We decide what matters before making anything.

    Timeframe

    3-5 days

    We map the approach.

    We align on priorities.

    We define what success looks like.

  • Concept

    /

    03

    Ideas tested before they become designs.

    Timeframe

    4-5 days

    We explore directions.

    We pressure-test assumptions.

    We choose the strongest path forward.

  • Design

    /

    04

    What was designed is what gets built.

    Timeframe

    2-3 days

    We build the system.

    We refine the hierarchy.

    We present with full rationale.

  • Build

    /

    05

    No handoffs. No translation loss.

    Timeframe

    4-8 weeks

    We develop exactly what was designed.

    We test across every breakpoint.

    We launch when it's ready — not before.

Have queries?
Need help?

Here are answers to the most common questions about partnering with us.

How do we start working together?

We begin with a short call to understand scope, timeline, and priorities. If there’s a fit, we define the engagement and start with a clear tattoo & art.

Who will I work with day to day?

The same person who leads the work stays involved throughout. No handoffs, no layered communication.

What’s included in the monthly hours?

Design, direction, and iteration within the agreed scope. That includes brand, web, and product work depending on the tattoo & art.

What happens if the scope changes?

We adjust the scope together before continuing. No silent overages, no unclear extensions.

Can I cancel or pause the engagement?

Yes. Engagements run month to month with a 30-day notice. Long-term setups can be adjusted if priorities shift.

How involved do I need to be?

We handle the work, but key decisions stay collaborative. Regular check-ins keep things aligned without slowing progress.

What do you need from me to get started?

Clarity on goals, access to existing materials, and a single point of book a session. Everything else is structured together at the start.
